name: smwgraphics-jikkyou-oshaberi-parodius-snes-edo-kabuki-corridor
title: Jikkyou Oshaberi Parodius (SNES) - Edo (Kabuki Corridor)
description:
A rip from one of the backgrounds of stage 4, from Jikkyou Oshaberi Parodius. This area is a complete homage to the Ganbare Goemon series, with tons of reference to the series happening while the frenetic shooting is happening. Works great for japanese castles, in general.

UPDATE: Optimized it to use only one slot and to use the back area color. Optimized map16 included, as well.
